claims.text: The rider's threshold showing that the artifacts describe one and the same trip is made out on the face of the record: trip_record EV-TRIP-00102, gps_trace EV-GPS-00102 and fare_breakdown EV-FARE-00102 all carry trip_id TRP-00102, and the trace's first fix at 2026-07-19T11:23:30+08:00 matches the trip_record's started_at to the second. POL-RD-08(a) is satisfied, and the burden of exculpation shifts to the driver.

On distance, POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure and forbids the rounded copy: gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 21.79 km, while trip_record.actual_distance_km (21.8 km) is a convenience copy that may not be cited for the threshold test. Measured against the platform's stored optimal of 20.4 km the excess is 1.39 km, which clears the clause's 0.8 km absolute limb but is only 6.8% of the optimal route and so does not clear the 20% limb. I do not ask the tribunal to hold that threshold met, and I do not overstate it; what this trip's own trace does establish is that the driver drove a longer route than the platform's optimal, that the difference is real and measured, and that the deviation comes in below the policy's floor.

The reroute is admitted rather than contested: the driver's own message at 11:29:04 reads 'boss BKE quite jam, i go Upper Bukit Timah ok?' and his statement reads 'I came off and used Upper Thomson'. POL-RD-03 is the only clause that could excuse it, and it requires an in-force traffic_advisory naming the affected road or segment. No such advisory exists in the pool: EV-ADVIS-00102-01 is MISSING, carries issue MISSING_ARTIFACT at BLOCKING severity with weight_multiplier 0.0, and its own record states that no LTA advisory covers the BKE or the Upper Bukit Timah corridor in the 11:16-11:55 window. The asserted cause of the detour has no artifact behind it.

Nor can the driver shift the detour onto the rider. POL-RD-04 exonerates a deviation only to the extent it is attributable to an instruction recorded in the chat_log that comes from the rider, is timeously given, and identifies a place or road specifically enough to act on, with chat_message.waypoint_hint as the corroborating field. The single message in EV-CHAT-00102 is the driver's own, no rider reply is recorded (delivered 11:29:05, read 11:29:40, no response), and waypoint_hint is null. There is no rider instruction and no rider consent, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable on its own terms and cannot convert the driver's request for permission into the rider's agreement.

Because the driver's only defence is a road condition asserted without the traffic_advisory POL-RD-03 requires, POL-RD-10(5) is engaged: escalation is mandatory where an exculpatory clause is invoked against an artifact that is missing from the pool, and that clause's own worked example is 'a closure asserted with no traffic_advisory'. Escalation under POL-RD-10 is terminal, replaces the ruling, and holds the disputed amount rather than collecting it; on a rider-filed dispute where the fare stands at CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd at 0.00, holding the amount is the only disposition that keeps the rider from carrying the contested charge. The artifact that would resolve the case is the LTA advisory for the BKE / Upper Bukit Timah corridor over the trip window.

The rider is not carrying a heightened corroboration burden. POL-RD-08's extra-corroboration trigger fires only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1 or fewer; the rider's profile shows 2 and 0, so the trigger does not fire and the trace needs no further support. Every other field on either profile - the driver's acceptance and cancellation rates, the rider's lifetime counters and prior disputes - is context only under POL-GEN-01, and I do not ask the tribunal to decide anything on it.

If the tribunal reaches POL-RD-02, the refund is arithmetic rather than discretionary: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 20.4 km optimal + 0.28 x 27 min optimal) x the fare_breakdown surge_multiplier of 1.0, plus the 0.80 platform fee and no ERP or surcharge lines, which is 27.46. Charged_total is 29.91, so the difference is 2.45 - above the 0.50 de minimis floor and far short of the 90% full-refund share. The policy's arithmetic, not the rider's round figure, is the number the tribunal must use if it reaches this clause.

claims.text: The POL-RD-01 numeric gate is not passed on this trip. The trace-measured excess over the platform's optimal route is 1.39 km against an optimal_distance_km of 20.4 km, which is 6.81% of optimal. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km AND greater than 0.8 km absolute, and both tests must pass. The percentage test fails by a wide margin, so on the clause's own words no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip.

The governing measurement is gps_trace.trace_distance_km at 21.79 km, not the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 21.8 km; POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure the field of record and forbids citing the rounded copy for the threshold test. Read either way the excess is at most about 1.40 km, and the percentage test — the one that actually bites here — still fails at under 7% against a 20% threshold.

The trace that carries the deciding number is clean. EV-GPS-00102 holds 193 fixes at a 10 second sample interval with 100% coverage, an empty gaps array and a max_gap_sec of 0.0. It therefore satisfies none of limbs (a) to (c) of POL-RD-07 — no gap over 90 seconds, no 500 m straight-line jump, no sustained interval above 30 seconds — so the excess is measured from an unimpaired trace, the measurement is reliable, and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises. The artifact's weight_multiplier is 1.0 with no issue codes.

Under POL-RD-08 the rider carries the initial burden and must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold, measured from an unimpaired gps_trace. The rider has not discharged that burden: the excess is 6.81%, below the 20% establishment test, so the burden never shifts to the driver and no exculpatory clause needs to be reached at all.

EV-ADVIS-00102-01 is MISSING and carries weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; no LTA advisory covers the BKE or the Upper Bukit Timah corridor in the 11:16-11:55 window. The driver does not invoke POL-RD-03 as the ground of decision, because there is no established deviation to excuse, and he is not asking the tribunal to run an exoneration on an absent artifact. That absence is citable but immaterial, and because no exculpatory clause is invoked against it, no POL-RD-10(5) trigger fires — the case is resolved at the POL-RD-01 gate on clean weight-1.0 evidence.

The rider's $7.00 claim has no foundation in this trip's fare arithmetic. The fare breakdown reconciles to the cent to a charged_total of $29.91 for 21.8 km and 32.0 billed minutes on rate card RC-SG-2026Q3-RYDEPLUS, with surge_multiplier 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (not from the trip_record, which does not carry the field), zero ERP, zero tolls and zero airport surcharge. Even on the platform's own hypothetical POL-RD-02 recomputation the whole difference is $2.45, not $7.00, and that hypothetical never arises because no deviation is established.

There is no billing-integrity defect for the rider to fall back on under POL-RD-09(4), which is available whether or not a deviation exists. erp_gantries is an empty array, tolls_erp is 0.00 and airport_surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. No charge line lacks a counterpart in the trace or trip record, so no standalone correction is due.

There is no repeat-deviation pattern behind this trip and no material deviation to uplift. The driver's deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 640, so neither limb of the POL-RD-06 pattern test is met (0 is below 3, and 0/640 is below 0.05). Independently, the excess here is nowhere near a MATERIAL deviation — not above 50% of optimal and not above 8.0 km — so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral can follow.

The chat log shows the driver messaged the rider at 11:29:04 that the BKE was congested and that he would use Upper Bukit Timah; the message was delivered and read by the rider at 11:29:40 with no objection, and the fare breakdown shows no additional charge for the route taken. That message is driver-originated, so it cannot exonerate under POL-RD-04(a), which requires the instruction to come from the rider, and the driver does not claim otherwise — but it shows the rider had notice of the route and paid nothing extra for it, which is why this is a complaint about route preference rather than about being overcharged.

The correct outcome is NO_ACTION, and under POL-GEN-03 that outcome is party-relative: on a rider-filed dispute it leaves the present state — payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — exactly as it stands. Nothing in the record supports returning any part of the $29.91 fare, and no monetary outcome in the rider's favour can be built on an excess of 6.81%.

ruling.explanation:
This was a $29.91 RYDE_PLUS trip from Woodlands to ION Orchard on 19 July 2026. The rider says the driver should have taken the BKE and instead went via Upper Thomson and Mandai, taking 32 minutes instead of 27, and asks for $7.00 back. The claim is not supported by the evidence, and the fare stands.

The governing test is POL-RD-01. The route actually driven, measured from the GPS trace, is 21.79 km (EV-GPS-00102, the governing field trace_distance_km; the 21.8 km on the trip record is the rounded copy the clause forbids citing for the threshold test). The platform's optimal route is 20.4 km (EV-TRIP-00102). The excess is 1.39 km, or 6.81% of optimal. POL-RD-01 makes a deviation established only where the excess is both more than 0.8 km in absolute terms AND more than 20% of optimal. The 0.8 km limb is cleared; the 20% limb is not, by a wide margin. Where either test fails the clause says no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. A real but small difference in route length is a route preference, not a refundable deviation.

On the driver's explanation: the in-app message ('boss BKE quite jam, i go Upper Bukit Timah ok?') and the statement that the BKE was slow near Dairy Farm explain the route choice but are a general assertion about traffic that cites no evidence, and under POL-RD-08 such an assertion carries no weight. No exculpatory clause is invoked against a missing artifact: the driver does not put POL-RD-03 forward. I note that the LTA traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00102-01) is absent from the record — weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT — so no POL-RD-03 exoneration could have been run in any event; but that absence does not require escalation here, because the case never reaches exoneration at all. It is decided at the POL-RD-01 gate on clean evidence, and it would be wrong to escalate a dispute the gate resolves.

On the money: the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00102) reconciles to the cent at $29.91 for 21.8 km and 32.0 billed minutes, surge_multiplier 1.0 read from the fare breakdown, no ERP, no tolls, no airport surcharge. No charge line lacks a counterpart in the trace or the trip record, so there is no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity correction available whether or not a deviation exists. The rider was billed 21.8 km against a trace of 21.79 km, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall and no POL-RD-04 driver compensation. Even on the platform's own hypothetical POL-RD-02 recomputation the entire difference between the $29.91 charged and a recomputed fare of $27.46 would be $2.45, not $7.00 — and that computation is never reached, because no deviation is established.

No repeat-deviation pattern applies: the driver's deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 640 completed trips in 90 days, and the excess is not a material deviation (neither above 50% of optimal nor above 8.0 km), so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral follows. No other clause in this category produces a referral on these facts.

Outcome: NO_ACTION. Under POL-GEN-03 this is party-relative: on a rider-filed dispute it leaves the present state exactly as it stands — payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd $0.00 are unchanged. Confidence is 0.95, below the 1.0 cap set by the unimpaired weight-1.0 GPS trace and trip record that carry the deciding measurement.
